title: What To EXPECT in Central TEXAS Real Estate MARKET UPDATE in 2025? [Full Market Breakdown]
description:
What to Expect in Central Texas Real Estate Market Update in 2025? Full Market Breakdown!
Are you thinking of moving to Central Texas? Wondering what the current market updates are for the area? In this video, we examine the latest housing trends in Killeen, Harker Heights, and Copperas Cove for 2025. With affordability at the top of mind across the U.S., many buyers and sellers ask the big question: Can I afford to buy? Should I sell now or wait? What's really happening in the market? Central Texas—especially around the Fort Hood area—paints a dynamic picture of today’s real estate landscape. Let’s explore what’s driving the changes and what they mean for you.

🏡 Central Texas Housing Market Update 2025 – What You Need to Know!

🔑 Key Trends:
✅ Killeen median price: $215K (↓ 8% YoY)
✅ Closed sales: ↓ 13% | Active listings: ↑ 18%
✅ Inventory: 4.2 months – still below healthy levels

🏘️ City Insights:
✅ Harker Heights: $315K median | Higher inventory
✅ Copperas Cove: $200K–$220K | Sales UP + new growth

📉 Sellers:
✅ Price RIGHT from the start
✅ Competing with builder incentives

📈 Buyers:
✅ More listings = more choices & negotiation power
✅ Median price per sq. ft.: $137 (↑ slightly)

🧭 Affordability:
✅ TX ranks #3 in U.S. | Median home price: $370K
✅ Still among the most affordable states

🏗️ Growth:
✅ New builds = population & urban expansion
✅ Copperas Cove is one to watch!
